title: Butternut Squash Cumin Soup with Ghee Tarka
meta_description: A silky butternut squash cumin soup finished with ghee-tempered cumin seeds — French velouté technique meets Pakistani tarka. Ready in 55 minutes.
og_title: Butternut Squash Cumin Soup with Ghee Tarka
og_description: Smooth French velouté meets Pakistani tarka: butternut squash cumin soup finished with sizzling ghee and roasted cumin seeds. Rich, grounded, and genuinely warming.

image_briefs.prompt: Close overhead shot of a wide, shallow white ceramic bowl of silky deep-orange butternut squash cumin soup on a dark slate surface. A pool of golden ghee floats on the surface with darkened whole cumin seeds and a dusting of red Kashmiri chilli. A few fresh coriander leaves scattered. Warm, moody autumn light from the left. No garnish clutter.
image_briefs.alt: Butternut squash cumin soup with ghee tarka in a white bowl on slate

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay on a linen cloth of the raw ingredients: a whole butternut squash cut in half showing orange flesh, a small bowl of whole cumin seeds, a jar of ghee, Kashmiri chilli powder in a wooden spoon, fresh coriander, a head of garlic, one onion. Natural daylight, no props.
image_briefs.alt: Ingredients for butternut squash cumin soup including whole cumin seeds and ghee

image_briefs.prompt: Action shot of a small stainless saucepan with ghee at high heat, whole cumin seeds mid-sizzle and visibly bubbling in the golden fat, held over a gas flame. Slightly shallow depth of field. Dark kitchen background. Steam rising.
image_briefs.alt: Whole cumin seeds crackling in hot ghee for the tarka finishing step

image_briefs.prompt: Three-quarter angle view of two white bowls of the finished butternut squash cumin soup on a dark wooden table, tarka poured, coriander garnish, a small jug of cream on the side, a torn piece of bread. Candlelight ambiance, warm tones.
image_briefs.alt: Two bowls of plated butternut squash cumin soup with ghee cumin tarka
